title: What is Styling in React Native?
overview: Styling in React Native is used to control the appearance of components. It helps developers define colors, sizes, spacing, layouts, and visual properties to create user interfaces.

example.title: Basic Styling

title: Using Style Prop
overview: The style prop is used to apply styles to React Native components. Styles can be written inline or by using a StyleSheet object.

title: StyleSheet API
overview: StyleSheet API allows developers to create reusable styles outside the component. It improves code organization and makes styling easier to manage.

title: Colors and Background Styling
overview: React Native allows customization of text and component colors using properties like color and backgroundColor.

title: Dimensions and Sizing
overview: Width and height properties are used to control component sizes. React Native supports fixed values as well as flexible layouts.

title: Spacing: Margin and Padding
overview: Margin creates space outside a component while padding creates space inside a component. These properties help create clean layouts.

title: Borders and Shadows
overview: Borders and shadows improve the visual appearance of components by adding separation, rounded corners, and depth effects.

title: Styling Best Practices
overview: Good styling practices include using reusable styles, keeping styles organized, avoiding repeated code, and creating responsive layouts.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Use StyleSheet for reusable styles.
✔ Keep styles separate from UI code.
✔ Use Flexbox for layouts.
✔ Create responsive designs.
